listing_fields.product_title: Minimalist White Silicone Smartwatch for Men & Women
listing_fields.item_highlights: Sleek Design | Soft Silicone Strap | Lightweight | Unisex Style | Daily Wear
bullet_points: MINIMALIST AESTHETIC: Features a clean, circular black display paired with a premium white strap for a modern, clutter-free look.
ULTRA-SOFT SILICONE: The high-quality silicone strap ensures maximum comfort for all-day wear, even during intense workouts.
ADJUSTABLE FIT: Designed with a secure buckle closure and multiple adjustment holes to provide a perfect fit for all wrist sizes.
LIGHTWEIGHT COMFORT: Engineered to be feather-light, making it ideal for sleeping, running, and continuous daily usage.
VERSATILE STYLE: The seamless white-on-black design complements both athletic gym wear and casual everyday outfits.
listing_fields.description: Elevate your everyday style with our Minimalist White Silicone Smartwatch. Designed for those who appreciate simplicity and elegance, this smartwatch features a stunning circular black interface that contrasts beautifully with its pure white silicone strap. Whether you are hitting the gym, heading to the office, or out for a casual brunch, its lightweight and ergonomic design ensures you stay comfortable all day long. The durable silicone material is sweat-resistant and easy to clean, making it the perfect companion for an active lifestyle. A perfect blend of fashion and functionality for both men and women.

1_lifestyle_usecase.purpose: Show the product in a real-world setting to build aspiration.
1_lifestyle_usecase.prompt: Photorealistic close-up shot of a person's wrist wearing a minimalist white silicone smartwatch. The person is wearing a light beige linen shirt, holding a white ceramic coffee cup. Soft natural morning sunlight, lifestyle aesthetic, high-end photography, 1:1 aspect ratio.

2_before_after.prompt: Split screen image. Left side: A cluttered, heavy old-fashioned metal watch on a wrist. Right side: The sleek, clean, minimalist white silicone smartwatch on a clean wrist. High contrast, studio lighting, 1:1 aspect ratio.

3_how_to_use.prompt: A macro shot showing hands adjusting the buckle of the white silicone smartwatch strap. Focus on the texture of the silicone and the precision of the buckle. Clean, bright, professional studio lighting, 1:1 aspect ratio.

4_enhanced_hero.prompt: High-end studio product photography of the white smartwatch floating slightly above a reflective white marble surface. Soft shadows, elegant lighting, extremely detailed textures of the silicone and the black glass display, 1:1 aspect ratio.
